svg.title: MedX — High-Level Architecture
svg.text: Container view · microservices by bounded context · event-driven · zero trust · every link encrypted
MEDX PLATFORM · HDS-certified cloud · primary EU region (3 AZs) + warm-standby DR region
OPA · RBAC + ABAC · consent & care relationships
SMS · e-mail · push · in-app · preferences · read status
Fees · invoices · refunds · ledger · tokenized payments (PSP)
EVENT BUS · Apache Kafka — domain events via transactional outbox · schema registry · 3× replication · idempotent consumers
database-per-service · private subnets · AES-256 at rest · TLS in transit
Used by ④ Records · ⑤ Prescription
Stripe / Adyen · PCI DSS L1 · 3-D Secure
